reviews.text: I would return. Good.

Without a doubt, Pilar and Malu are the most trustworthy veterinarians. They are both professional and empathetic with our furry friends. I recommend them 100%. They are honest and inspire confidence. My kittens are always in good hands with them, even though our visits are in the morning.
Thank you, team!
Thank you very much for your kind feedback. Best regards.
Excellent service, I've been with them for years.

I've taken one of my dogs to this place twice now, and they've treated her wonderfully. The doctor and the receptionist were very kind; they gave Lucy special care, and it's clear they work out of passion and love for animals.
The best veterinary clinic I've ever been to. Very professional, reasonable prices, and above all, wonderful people. They truly care about our beloved pets.
The vet was wonderful, super attentive and patient with the kittens. Highly recommended if your cat is special like mine (she doesn't let anyone touch her).

We went for the first time today and it was great. They gave us an appointment for the same day and the service was excellent. They gave us several tips that previous vets hadn't. And our kitty was super happy! 😍 …
Lovely professionals who give you the time and attention you need.
Very good veterinarian.
Thank you very much for your kind feedback. Best regards.
Thank you very much for your feedback. Best regards.
Very professional service. 100% recommended.
Excellent care from the doctor and assistant! I've taken my dog ​​there 3 times.
I think trimming a chihuahua's nails is very expensive.

We've been going to this clinic for... I can't even remember. This is my third pet, and I only have words of gratitude for them. They're the best professionals to advise you on any illness, behavior, diet... They have many years of experience, and it shows.
They treat my dog ​​wonderfully and are very professional; I definitely recommend them.
Thank you so much for your trust. Best regards.

We went to this veterinarian for an echocardiogram and a nail trim. The service was very professional and attentive at all times. The specialist clearly explained the test results, answering all our questions and putting us at ease.

During the nail trim, they treated Brownie with great patience and gentleness, preventing him from getting nervous.

Overall, we were very happy with the experience: the place is well-equipped, the staff is friendly, and the quality of service gave us a lot of confidence. We will definitely return for future checkups.

I 100% recommend this clinic. It's very professional, efficient, honest with clients, and very friendly. It's a small but excellent place! Making an appointment is almost 95% recommended.
They always treat us wonderfully, have good prices, and are honest and very professional.

They are very nice girls and they took excellent care of my Daxter when he got sick. He's currently being checked out and everything is going very well. Thank you so much. They are true professionals.

We are delighted with the service, professionalism, and gentleness with the kittens.
You are incredibly efficient. You always give us great advice for our pets.
Thank you so much for your dedication.
We're so happy with this vet. They're lovely and take great care of our puppy. Highly, highly recommended!!!
Excellent professionals. I recommend them 100%.

I took my dog ​​Iris to the emergency room and they treated her wonderfully. They are very kind and professional. I highly recommend them. The vet has been around for years and is very good. Thank you.
Thank you very much for your kind feedback. Best regards.

I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less. It was terrible. I made an appointment only to be ignored and instead try to do what they want, which is to get money out of me. I explained the reason for the urgency, as I was going to a funeral and it was very urgent. Oh well, it's sorted now, I won't be going back.
Thank you very much for your feedback. Best regards.

I only have words of gratitude for this clinic and its team of professionals. My dog ​​Rasty has been treated at this clinic since he was a puppy, and he's now 17 years old. I have complete confidence in the entire team. My Rasty recently underwent surgery for a malignant tumor on his lip for the third time, and I can only say THANK YOU for the care, attention, and professionalism they show to the animals. They only want what's best for them, they advise you at every step, and they are incredibly kind, approachable, and caring. Words can't express my gratitude because I have complete faith in the entire team. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
Thank you for your kind feedback. Best regards.
They are very kind, this is my trusted clinic in Madrid for my cat.
Thank you very much for your feedback.
Thank you so much for your review...we're always delighted to see your little ones at the clinic.
They are my veterinarians for many years, kind, friendly, and they know what they're talking about, and their prices are reasonable.
Exceptional
100% humanity and professionalism // Yesterday I had to put Boli to sleep and they did it with such respect and care, you could tell they were feeling it too ❤️ Thank you
Friendly, professional, and on time!
Very attentive and helpful. Excellent service and support.

My babies have been going here for four years! First it was my dog, and then my two cats. One of my cats sadly passed away in August, and I went through the whole process there. The two women there are very kind and understand loss perfectly. My second feline baby is still being treated there for kidney disease, and honestly, everything has always gone well. Thank you! I've had many experiences at different vets, and it's hard to find one that provides good care.
Thank you so much for your feedback. We're always delighted to have Clarise at our center.
